root_causes.description: product-catalog, a leaf service, exhibits sustain~10s server-side latency (p50=p95=p99=10000ms) with no error logs, injecting 10-15s timeouts that propagate up through recommendation to frontend, producing the frontend error/timeout spike seen by the watchdog.

evidence.observed_value: p50=10000.000 p95=10000.000 p99=10000.000 mean=9954.789 (propagated from product-catalog)

evidence.expected_baseline: no error logs; confirms slow-but-not-failing latency fault

root_causes.description: recommendation shows identical 10s p99 latency, but as an upstream caller of the slow product-catalog it reflects propagated latency rather than an independent fault.
email container shows restart/back-off events and a restart-rate bump, but this is a low-impact secondary issue (checkout error rate stayed ~0.004) and does not explain the frontend error spike.

evidence.query_or_id: BackOff: Back-off restarting failed container email in pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw_otel-demo(c9cf2589-71fd-45ed-bb7c-39ada7acd0a9) (count=5)
evidence.observed_value: email container restart/back-off; 'Killing: Container email definition changed, will be restarted' (count=2)

remediation_steps: Inspect product-catalog deployment/config for an injected latency (e.g. flagd latency flag or fault-injection) and disable it; check recent rollouts/config maps.

Restart or roll back product-catalog pods and confirm p99 latency returns to baseline via histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="product-catalog",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[2m])) by (le)).
Verify frontend recovery: sum(rate(calls_total{service_name="frontend",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[2m])) and frontend trace p95 drop back to normal.
Add/raise client timeouts and retries between frontend→recommendation→product-catalog to bound blast radius.
Separately investigate the email pod restart/back-off loop (image pull/config change) as an independent cleanup item.
